logging: A name card or plate logs as the shot it rides.
A video tile counts as a face when it fills at least half the frame (the pinned, two-up, half-frame and full tiles).
A prop insert counts as a face or hand only with a hand in frame; a table overhead with her hand in it counts.
The floor POV (30.06b) is a screen-close class shot by framing-v3's class list but not a face.
conventions.timing: 96 BPM; 1 beat = 15 f; 1 bar = 60 f. Set-pieces, cards, posts, holds and music-bound cuts on the writer's beat model. Conversations cut on the turn (§4.7.3 rule 8, PROPOSED, the v3 default), L-cuts ≤ 8 f; each conversation block closes on the grid. Lines are placed at the 3.2 TARGET spans; re-sit them on the takes at the lock (±10%).
conventions.posts: Unvoiced posts hold at least 0.25 s + 0.05 s a character from their pop (the read floor); read-aloud posts are voiced lines.
conventions.moves_rule: No drift, rack, whip, pan or macro on a shot with a real line, post, card or must-read record in picture; soft focus never touches record text (§4.7.3 rule 6).

board_calls.call: The model's 4-bar voiced diagram is cut in four on NELEH's clauses: section (the chairs) → sheet with a PAN down the arrow (control) → detail (the key ring, VOTES: 0 on the cut-off) → detail (the CEO box, the overlap, the moth). A set-piece cuts every ≤ 2 bars with a size change (§4.7.3 rule 8). Same 4 bars.

The click gets a screen macro: 26.05 the arrow steps in (2 beats, was 3), 26.06 an integer 2x of the laptop's own pixels on Cancel (1 beat; macro 1 of 2), 26.06b the drop in the silence (2 beats). The click lands on the cut into 26.06b at the model's frame, so D6 stays exactly 5 beats. It replaces framing-v3's drawing 5 (the dialog redrawn at 2x): no new art.

3.2's single [OTS] for "super." (ruling 6 default) over framing-v3's MCU + grid: the line and its listeners in one frame. 3 beats → 2: the line ends f17 and the script's listener's hold is 1 beat, so the model's third beat was slack (−15 f; the drop-out, the [CU] and F1.2 are untouched).

Screen direction: NELEH's boardroom singles are LEFT third facing right (the room's line, as drawBoard2S stages her: framing-v3 §2.3 and §4.7.3 rule 5, 'in an exit the room's own staging sets the line'). At her own desk (27.02) she is right third facing left. The script's 'anyone framed alone faces from the right' is read as 'the left of frame never holds Mas'.

The hearts shot is split 7 beats + 1: the blue heart landing on Mada's spinner is macro 2 of 2 (framing-v3's 27.09b). The eulogy post enters at f20 and has scrolled off before the macro cut, so no record is cropped (post read ≥ 3.25 s holds).

Cut on the turn (§4.7.3 rule 8, the v3 default): each conversation cut is frame-accurate at the cue sheet's overlap, L-cuts ≤ 8 f; each block is closed back onto the beat grid by its last shot (a read floor, a scripted hold or a rack), so everything after stays on the grid. Net with 26.09: −90 f (−3.75 s) against the beat model; set-pieces, cards, posts and holds otherwise keep the writer's lengths.
NELEH's hand, resting by the ? with the capped marker, is in the overhead: TASYA's real read (27.29) then lands on a listener within a beat (§4.3 rule 5), which the cut 2S used to do.

NEW ANGLE: the avalanche's 'hundreds' plays over Mas's shoulder onto the monitor across the dark room (one frame of scale with him in it), then cuts in to his face (29.21) on the same axis. It's still his side (his silhouette, his monitor). Fallback: the scripted full-bleed [POV].
3.2's one still wide for the landlord (ruling 6 default): a real line plays whole on one still shot (§4.7.3 rules 6, 8). framing-v3's floor / ceiling / Tasya split and its ceiling plate are not used.
No drift on the vault: the (REPORTED) rail is must-read record, so the shot plays dry (the act's one drift is 26A.01).
